$comment: Accepted high or critical production advisories, read by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs. One entry per GHSA id (never per package): { "id": "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx", "reason": "why it does not apply or why it waits, in a sentence", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. An entry expires after at most 90 days and the audit job fails again on its own. Empty on purpose: an entry here is the Owner's accepted risk, not something to add to make a job green.
